allow: PowerShell(Start-Process -NoNewWindow -FilePath "npm" -ArgumentList "run","start" -RedirectStandardOutput "$env:TEMP\\mg-start.log" -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\\mg-start.err"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 12; foreach \($p in @\('/','/trustees','/request','/rules','/memorial','/accessibility','/schedule/month','/offline','/login'\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; "$p -> $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "$p -> FAILED $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path node_modules\\sharp\) { "sharp: yes" } else { "sharp: no" }; if \(Test-Path $env:USERPROFILE\\AppData\\Local\\ms-playwright\) { "pw-browsers: yes"; Get-ChildItem $env:USERPROFILE\\AppData\\Local\\ms-playwright -Name } else { "pw-browsers: no" })

PowerShell($c = \(Get-Command supabase -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($c\) { "supabase: $\($c.Source\)" } else { "supabase: not found" }; $d = \(Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($d\) { "docker: $\($d.Source\)"; docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}' } else { "docker: not found" }; $p = \(Get-Command psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($p\) { "psql: $\($p.Source\)" } else { "psql: not found" })

PowerShell(Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; try { Remove-Item tsconfig.tsbuildinfo -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {}; try { Remove-Item public\\sw.js -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {}; "deleted: .next, tsconfig.tsbuildinfo, public/sw.js"; ""; "remaining supabase/:"; Get-ChildItem -Recurse supabase -File | ForEach-Object { "  " + $_.FullName.Replace\(\(Get-Location\).Path + '\\',''\) })
